long_description:
Save the date! The 12th Indie Meme Film Festival returns to Austin from April 21–26, 2027.

Join us for six days of bold independent South Asian cinema, filmmaker conversations, community gatherings and unforgettable stories from across the region and its diasporas.

We’re beginning the countdown with a look back at IMFF 2026. Follow the event for weekly Throwback Thursday moments, festival memories and the latest IMFF 2027 announcements.

The complete lineup, schedule, venues and ticket information are coming soon.

Stay in the know by joining the Indie Meme newsletter. 

Also check out other Festivals in Austin, Entertainment events in Austin.
